blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.prompt: Where do you keep the booze?
exercises.why: The direct object of «держать»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I turn over a page of the book.
exercises.why: The direct object of «переворачивать»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я бы хотел получить ___ (копия) протокола о вскрытии.
exercises.prompt: I'd like a copy of the autopsy report.
exercises.why: The direct object of «получить»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Бобру нужно повалить сотни деревьев, чтобы запрудить ___ (река).

exercises.why: The direct object of «запрудить»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
